environment: Node.js full application VM with shared DOM stub
limitations: Not browser visual-layout, native focus/input, emulator execution or native Save As QA.

results.name: Gameplay panel initializes in the Scene gameplay section with all saved fields
Mode selection creates exactly one undo snapshot without replacing actor references
A numeric change uses validated configuration and a single undo entry
An invalid numeric edit cannot mutate the project or enter history
An empty numeric input is rejected instead of becoming zero
The panel never assigns a first player or room implicitly
Changing rooms preserves actor IDs and shows the old references for repair
Deleting a configured room leaves a visible repair option without reassigning it
Entity selects filter roles and retain an optional no-target choice
Switching editor rooms does not change the configured playable room
Repeated refreshes retain the select element and do not duplicate missing options
Refresh preserves text being entered into an active numeric field
Viewer mode preserves custom assembly and scene packing settings
Editing a room navigates by its saved identity without changing gameplay settings
Binding shortcut opens the chosen player in Entity Studio
Build and Play invokes the existing shared build command exactly once
A failed build displays the required next action
Invalid references stop the panel build action before the shared builder
Undo restores both saved configuration and visible controls
Gameplay entry restores current configuration after an external edit
Gameplay panel handlers report no unexpected application errors
